data_fields.name: max_damagers_per_target
data_fields.donor_constant: not capped in donor; Frankendom ruling MAX_ATTACKERS = 3

best_idea: Pay a kill only if the victim's previous death is at least N seconds old, and cap a kill's base reward at a multiple of the killer's own worth, so farming and feeding stop paying.
decision_why: Keep the worth timer and the self-relative caps (anti-farm and anti-feed for the kill path) and the damage-share split; drop the realm-points, bounty and money currencies (one ledger: XP and loot). Donor defects (out-flag overwrite, comment/code mismatch on the battleground cap, unclamped gap factor) are fixed in the sketch or listed.
acceptance: A server test: a victim killed again within 300 played-seconds of their last death gives 0 XP and 0 RP; a kill never gives the awardee more XP than 125% of their own XP value; a three-damager group's RP total is 1.25 times the single-damager base share.
